22566-dorothy-and-the-wizard-in-oz.title: Dorothy And The Wizard In Oz
22566-dorothy-and-the-wizard-in-oz.creator: Unknown
22566-dorothy-and-the-wizard-in-oz.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. my little correspondents for "more about the Wizard." It seems the jolly old fellow made hosts of friends in the first Oz book, in spite of the fact that he frankly acknowledged himself "a humbug." The children had heard how he mounted into the sky in a balloon and they were all waiting for him to come down again. So what could I do but tell "what happened to the Wizard afterward"?

24034-the-king-s-mirror.title: The King S Mirror
24034-the-king-s-mirror.creator: Unknown
24034-the-king-s-mirror.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Before my coronation there was no event in childhood that impressed itself on my memory with marked or singular distinction. My father's death, the result of a chill contracted during a hunting excursion, meant no more to me than a week of rooms gloomy and games forbidden; the decease of King Augustin, my uncle, appeared at the first instant of even less importance.

arxiv-2102-00253.title: A functional approach to the next to eikonal approximation of high energy gravitational scattering
arxiv-2102-00253.creator: A.R. Fazio, E.A. Reyes R
arxiv-2102-00253.description: Abstract The Fradkin-Schwinger functional methods to represent a Green function in an external gravitational field are used to study the eikonal and the next-to-eikonal limit, including the nonlinear gravitational interactions, of the scattering amplitudes of an ultra-relativistic scalar particle on a static super-massive scalar target in the nearly forward limit.

arxiv-2111-09643.title: Towards long term sustainability of c-Si solar panels: the environmental benefits of glass sheet recovery
arxiv-2111-09643.creator: Marcos Paulo Belançon, Marcelo Sandrini, Francisnara Tonholi, Leandro Silva Herculano, Gustavo Sanguino Dias
arxiv-2111-09643.description: Abstract The cover glass in a silicon solar panel accounts for about 2/3 of the device’s weight. Recycling these devices at their end-of-life is fundamental to reducing the industry’s environmental impact. Here we investigate the recovery of these glass sheets by a heat-assisted mechanical process.

arxiv-2202-00647.title: Radial Kohn-Sham problem via integral-equation approach
arxiv-2202-00647.creator: Jānis Užulis, Andris Gulans
arxiv-2202-00647.description: Abstract We present a numerical tool for solving the non-relativistic Kohn-Sham problem for spherically-symmetric atoms. It treats the Schrödinger equation as an integral equation relying heavily on convolutions. The solver supports different types of exchange-correlation functionals including screened and long-range corrected hybrids. We implement a new method for treating range separation based on the complementary error function kernel.

arxiv-2203-04934.title: The environmental dependence of the stellar and gas-phase mass-metallicity relation at 2 < z < 4 2<z<4
arxiv-2203-04934.creator: A. Calabrò, L. Guaita, L. Pentericci, F. Fontanot, M. Castellano, G. De Lucia, T. Garofalo, P. Santini, F. Cullen, A. Carnall, B. Garilli, M. Talia, G. Cresci, M. Franco, J.P.U. Fynbo, N. P. Hathi, M. Hirschmann, A. Koekemoer, M. Llerena, L. Xie
arxiv-2203-04934.description: Abstract In the local universe, galaxies in clusters typically show different physical and chemical properties compared to more isolated systems. Understanding how this difference originates and whether it is already in place at high redshift is still a matter of debate.

arxiv-2204-13339.title: An Overview of Color Transfer and Style Transfer for Images and Videos
arxiv-2204-13339.creator: Shiguang Liu
arxiv-2204-13339.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Shiguang Liu. Image or video appearance features (e.g., color, texture, tone, illumination, and so on) reflect one’s visual perception and direct impression of an image or video. Given a source image (video) and a target image (video), the image (video) color transfer technique aims to process the color of the source image or video (note that the source image or video is also referred to the reference image or video in some literature) to make it look like that of the target image or

arxiv-2205-11628.title: Entanglement dynamics: Generalized master equation
arxiv-2205-11628.creator: for uniformly accelerated two-level systems
arxiv-2205-11628.description: Abstract We propose a new form for the quantum master equation in the theory of open quantum systems. This new formalism allows one to describe the dynamics of two-level systems moving along different hyperbolic trajectories with distinct proper times. In the Born-Markov approximation, we consider a quantum massless scalar field coupled with two-level systems.

arxiv-2307-01169.title: Analyzing and Improving Greedy 2-Coordinate Updates for Equality-Constrained Optimization via Steepest Descent in the 1-Norm
arxiv-2307-01169.creator: Amrutha Varshini Ramesh, Aaron Mishkin, Mark Schmidt, Yihan Zhou, Jonathan Wilder Lavington, Jennifer She
arxiv-2307-01169.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Amrutha Varshini Ramesh, Aaron Mishkin, Mark Schmidt, Yihan Zhou, Jonathan Wilder Lavington, Jennifer She. We consider minimizing a smooth function subject to a summation constraint over its variables. By exploiting a connection between the greedy 2-coordinate update for this problem and equality-constrained steepest descent in the 1-norm, we give a convergence rate for greedy selection under a proximal Polyak-Łojasiewicz assumption that is faster than random selection and independent of the problem dimension n n .

arxiv-2406-12149.title: Tight Streaming Lower Bounds for Deterministic Approximate Counting
arxiv-2406-12149.creator: Yichuan Wang
arxiv-2406-12149.description: Abstract We study the streaming complexity of k k -counter approximate counting . In the k k -counter approximate counting problem, we are given an input string in [ k ] n [k]^{n} , and we are required to approximate the number of each j j ’s ( j ∈ [ k ] j\in[k] ) in the string.

arxiv-2408-11692.title: A JWST MIRI MRS View of the η \eta Tel Debris Disk and its Brown Dwarf Companion
arxiv-2408-11692.creator: Yiwei Chai, Christine H. Chen, Kadin Worthen, Alexis Li, Antranik A. Sefilian, William Balmer, Dean C. Hines, David R. Law, B. A. Sargent, Mark Wyatt, Cicero X. Lu, Marshall D. Perrin, Isabel Rebollido, Emily Rickman, G. C. Sloan
arxiv-2408-11692.description: Abstract We report JWST MIRI MRS observations of the β \beta Pic moving group member, η \eta Tel A, along with its brown dwarf binary companion, η \eta Tel B. Following PSF subtraction, we recover the spatially resolved flux from the debris disk around η \eta Tel A, along with the position of the companion exterior to the disk.

arxiv-2503-07987.title: Emission and absorption lines in the photospheric radius expansion bursts of 4U 1820–30 Preprint: Z. Li
arxiv-2503-07987.creator: Wenhui Yu, Zhaosheng Li, Yuanyue Pan, Xuejuan Yang, Yupeng Chen, Shu Zhang, Maurizio Falanga
arxiv-2503-07987.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Wenhui Yu, Zhaosheng Li, Yuanyue Pan, Xuejuan Yang, Yupeng Chen, Shu Zhang, Maurizio Falanga. We analyze the emission and absorption lines during photospheric radius expansion (PRE) X-ray bursts from the ultracompact binary 4U 1820–30, observed with the Neutron Star Interior Composition Explorer (NICER). Using Monte Carlo simulations to estimate the significance, we identified a 1 kiloelectron volt (keV) emission line from 14 bursts, a 3 keV absorption line from 12 bursts, and a 1.6 keV absorption line from one burst.

arxiv-2503-14477.title: Calibrating Verbal Uncertainty as a Linear Feature to Reduce Hallucinations In this paper, we employ the term ‘verbal’ to mean ‘pertaining to words rather than meaning or substance,’ as opposed to ‘spoken rather than written’ (refer to Merriam-Webster’s definitions: https://www.merriam-webster.com/d
arxiv-2503-14477.creator: Ziwei Ji, Lei Yu, Yeskendir Koishekenov, Yejin Bang, Anthony Hartshorn, Alan Schelten, Cheng Zhang, Pascale Fung, Nicola Cancedda
arxiv-2503-14477.description: Abstract LLMs often adopt an assertive language style also when making false claims. Such “overconfident hallucinations” mislead users and erode trust. Achieving the ability to express in language the actual degree of uncertainty around a claim is therefore of great importance.

Carlet on the sum-freedom of the binary multiplicative inverse function can be stated as follows: For each pair of positive integers ( n , k ) (n,k) with 3 ≤ k ≤ n − 3 3\leq k\leq n-3 , there is a k k -dimensional 𝔽 2 \mathbb{F}_{2} -subspace E E of 𝔽 2 n \mathbb{F}_{2^{n}} such that ∑ 0 ≠ ∈ E 1 / u = 0 \sum_{0\neq\in E}1/u=0 .

arxiv-2506-17402.title: Finite time path field theory and a new type of universal quantum spin chain quench behaviour
arxiv-2506-17402.creator: Domagoj Kuić, Alemka Knapp, Diana Šaponja-Milutinović
arxiv-2506-17402.description: Abstract We discuss different quench protocols for Ising and XY spin chains in a transverse magnetic field. With a sudden local magnetic field quench as a starting point, we generalize our approach to a large class of local non-sudden quenches.

arxiv-2601-04253.title: Paper Skygest: Personalized Academic Recommendations on Bluesky
arxiv-2601-04253.creator: Sophie Greenwood, Nikhil Garg
arxiv-2601-04253.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Sophie Greenwood, Nikhil Garg. We build, deploy, and evaluate Paper Skygest , a custom personalized social feed for scientific content posted by a user’s network on Bluesky and the AT Protocol. We leverage a new capability on emerging decentralized social media platforms: the ability for anyone to build and deploy feeds for other users, to use just as they would a native platform-built feed.

pmc-10499708.title: Echocardiographic parameters in COVID-19 patients and their association with ICU mortality: a prospective multicenter observational study
pmc-10499708.creator: Amarja Ashok Havaldar, Merugu Vinay Kumar, Raman Kumar, Surya Prakash Yarramalle, Mohammad Saif Khan, Krushna Chandra Misra, Shubhangi Kamble, Atul Sangale, Jay Prakash, Munta Kartik, Sumithra Selvam
pmc-10499708.description: BackgroundEchocardiography has become an integral part of the management of critically ill patients. It helps to diagnose and treat various conditions. COVID-19 patients can develop cardiac dysfunction. We planned to study the echocardiographic parameters in COVID-19 patients.MethodsWe conducted a prospective observational multicenter study after institutional ethical committee approval. COVID-19 pneumonia patients admitted to the intensive care unit (ICU) were enrolled.

pmc-10691584.title: Comparison of Noninvasive Cardiac Output Monitoring by Electrical Cardiometry with Transthoracic Echocardiography in Postoperative Paediatric Cardiac Surgical Patients - A Prospective Observational Study
pmc-10691584.creator: Raj A. Pedgaonkar, Naveen G. Singh, Manasa Dhananjaya, PS Nagaraja, KS Nagesh, V Prabhakar
pmc-10691584.description: Aim:The present study was conducted to validate cardiac output (CO) and cardiac index (CI) obtained from electrical cardiometry (EC) ICON ® with transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) in postoperative pediatric cardiac surgical patients.Materials and Methods:A prospective observational study was conducted in 25 pediatric patients with age < 10 years who underwent elective cardiac surgery.

pmc-11415730.title: An activity theory perspective on interprofessional teamwork in long-term care
pmc-11415730.creator: Nicolas Fernandez, Nicolas Gulino
pmc-11415730.description: BackgroundTeamwork in healthcare is shaped by reciprocal interactions among individual team members and their clinical context. Cultural Historical Activity Theory (CHAT) provides a framework to study teamwork from a developmental perspective. We observed interactions between members of an Interprofessional Healthcare Team (IHT) to identify practical guidelines for educators.

pmc-11507473.title: Exploring the Effects of Qigong, Tai Chi, and Yoga on Fatigue, Mental Health, and Sleep Quality in Chronic Fatigue and Post-COVID Syndromes: A Systematic Review with Meta-Analysis
pmc-11507473.creator: Hermann Fricke-Comellas, Alberto Marcos Heredia-Rizo, María Jesús Casuso-Holgado, Jesús Salas-González, Lourdes María Fernández-Seguín, Ciara M Hughes
pmc-11507473.description: Background/Objectives: Chronic fatigue syndrome (CFS) and post-COVID syndrome (PCS) pose a substantial socioeconomic burden. The aim of this systematic review was to assess current evidence regarding the effect of the most popular forms of movement-based mindful exercises, i.e., qigong, tai chi, and yoga, on fatigue and associated symptoms in CFS and PCS.

pmc-11510451.title: Preparation and Properties of Flexible Phenolic Silicone Hybrid Aerogels for Thermal Insulation
pmc-11510451.creator: Danni Ye, Hongli Lv, Zhenrong Zheng, Lijuan Luo, Stefano Cardea
pmc-11510451.description: In order to prepare flexible thermal protection aerogel materials, using dimethyldimethoxysilane (DMDMS) and methyltrimethoxysilane (MTMS) as co-precursors, isocyanate-propyltrimethoxysilane (CFS-006) was added to the co-precursor as a coupling agent, and resorcinol and formaldehyde were added to the sol solution to prepare a phenolic silicone hybrid aerogel (FAS) by the sol–gel method.

pmc-11526591.title: Adolescents’ impairment due to climate anxiety is associated with self-efficacy and behavioral engagement: a cross-sectional analysis in Quebec (Canada)
pmc-11526591.creator: Anne-Marie Turcotte-Tremblay, Gabrielle Fortier, Richard E Bélanger, Claude Bacque Dion, Rabi Joel Gansaonré, Scott T Leatherdale, Slim Haddad
pmc-11526591.description: BackgroundThe current understanding of climate anxiety among adolescents is sparse. This study identifies the characteristics of adolescents living in Quebec (Canada) who experience impairments induced by climate anxiety, who have feelings of self-efficacy and who adopt pro-environment behaviors. It also characterizes the association between climate anxiety, feelings of self-efficacy, and environmental actions.

pmc-11694582.title: The Effect of a Program Based on Roy’s Adaptation Model on Coping Skills of Children of People with Multiple Sclerosis
pmc-11694582.creator: Kobra Mohammadi, Hossein A. Mehralian, Shahla Abolhassani, Soleiman Kheiri
pmc-11694582.description: Background:The health of children is affected by Multiple Sclerosis (MS) in their parents and various complications of it. Given this, this study was conducted to investigate the effect of a program based on Roy’s adaptation model on the coping skills of children of MS patients.

pmc-12406889.title: Improving tuberculosis treatment adherence: a qualitative study of patients’ perspectives from a pragmatic trial of the tuberculosis treatment support tools intervention
pmc-12406889.creator: Javier Roberti, Daniela Moraes Morelli, Omar Alfonso Aguilar-Vidrio, Agnes Suyanto, Priscilla Carmiol-Rodriguez, Alejandra Tolentino, Enrique Chen-Liang, Jennifer Sprecher, Fernando Rubinstein, Sarah Iribarren
pmc-12406889.description: AbstractObjectiveTo explore patient perspectives on using a digital adherence technology (DAT) for tuberculosis (TB) treatment, specifically, the TB Treatment Support Tools (TB-TST) intervention, which integrates a mobile app designed to enhance patient-centred support, monitoring and communication, alongside a drug metabolite test.DesignQualitative study conducted as part of a pragmatic randomised controlled trial.Setting and participantsFour public reference hospitals in Argentina.

pmc-12428834.title: Chemsex as a Diagnostic Challenge: Toward Recognition in ICD-12 and Integrated Treatment Approaches—A Narrative Review
pmc-12428834.creator: Justyna Śniadach, Wiktor Orlof, Justyna Sołowiej-Chmiel, Aleksandra Kicman, Sylwia Szymkowiak, Napoleon Waszkiewicz, José Javier Miguel-Hidalgo
pmc-12428834.description: Chemsex is a phenomenon involving the intentional use of psychoactive substances before or during sexual activity, especially among men who have sex with men (MSM). It is associated with various health risks, including substance dependence, risky sexual behaviors, and both mental and somatic disorders.

pmc-12494734.title: Comparing hierarchical and inductive methods reveals fundamental differences in social vulnerability rankings
pmc-12494734.creator: Lotte Savelberg, Ylenia Casali, Marc van den Homberg, Jazmin Zatarain Salazar, Tina Comes
pmc-12494734.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Social vulnerability assessments play a crucial role in guiding the allocation of budgets and resources for effective disaster preparedness and humanitarian response. Climate change, escalating conflicts, and the climate finance and humanitarian funding gap make social vulnerability assessments essential. Despite advances in data collection, availability, and analysis, there remains a lack of consensus regarding the most suitable method to assess social vulnerability.

pmc-12618097.title: Heparan sulfate as a central modulator of growth factor dynamics in tissue regeneration
pmc-12618097.creator: Keyu Tao, Ali Shokoohmand, Simon M Cool, Raymond A A Smith
pmc-12618097.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Growth factors (GFs) are potent regenerative proteins that modulate biological responses and stimulate tissue repair by activating cell signaling pathways to enhance proliferation, differentiation, and migration. However, the rapid degradation and diffusion characteristics of GFs necessitate the use of supraphysiological doses and/or frequent administrations to maintain therapeutic effects, which can result in reduced efficacy and an increased risk of adverse events.

pmc-12751325.title: Prevalence and associated factors of hypertensive emergency among hypertensive crisis patients admitted to the emergency department at Hawassa University Comprehensive Specialized Hospital, Ethiopia
pmc-12751325.creator: Teshome Shanko, Desalegn Dawit Assele, Zemedkihun Motera, Yitayew Ewnetu Mohammed
pmc-12751325.description: BackgroundHypertension is a major global health problem that affects approximately 1.4 billion people worldwide, and 1–2% of this population experience hypertensive crisis. Hypertensive emergency is a subtype of hypertensive crisis associated with target organ damage and is linked with increased morbidity and mortality.

pmc-13103369.title: A deployable digital twin framework for bolt-torque specification compression in EV chassis assembly
pmc-13103369.creator: Haijun Wang, Zhijie Huang, Zhengxin Lan, Tie Xu, Hao Chen, Deyang Luo, Danhua Chen
pmc-13103369.description: Bolted-joint tightening affects both structural integrity and line performance in EV chassis assembly, yet production torque tables are often conservative to accommodate variability in joint mechanics and shop-floor conditions. This study uses a deployable digital-twin workflow to reduce torque variants while jointly considering mechanics constraints, AGV-related logistics, and cost/OEE objectives.

pmc-13153001.title: Robotic-arm assisted total hip arthroplasty using a short metaphyseal filling collared femoral implant through a direct anterior approach: minimum two-year outcomes
pmc-13153001.creator: Robert Marchand, Emily Kaczynski, Kelly Taylor, Chase Smitterberg, Michael A Mont
pmc-13153001.description: IntroductionShort, collared, metaphyseal-filling femoral stems preserve proximal bone and achieve stable fixation while reducing stress shielding compared to diaphyseal-engaging stems. Early six-month data for one such stem demonstrated improved patient-reported outcomes with no implant-related complications. This study extends follow-up of the same cohort to a minimum of two years to evaluate (a) functional outcomes, (b) implant-related complications, and (c) survivorship.

pmc-13379528.title: Beyond the Court: Psychological Indicators Differentiate Elite and Sub-elite South Australian Youth Basketball Players
pmc-13379528.creator: Michael Rogers, Alyson J. Crozier, Jordan L. Fox, Grant R. Tomkinson
pmc-13379528.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundUnderstanding differences in non-game performance indicators—spanning physical, motor, technical, tactical, and psychological domains—may assist athlete profiling and monitoring in youth basketball. However, comparatively little is known about whether standardised psychological measures differentiate competitive standards in youth basketball.ObjectivesThis study aimed to quantify mean differences in non-game performance indicators between elite and sub-elite South Australian youth basketball players using a quantitative cross-sectional design.MethodsAll South Australian under-16 and under-18 Division 1 and 2 district basketball players were invited to participate.

pmc-13423636.title: Screening for atrial fibrillation in older adults in primary care: a cross-sectional pilot study in Qatar
pmc-13423636.creator: Ahmed Sameer Alnuaimi, Shahid Ahmad, Abdullah Syed, Babur Khan, Zaheer Ahmed, Tahir Hameed, Muslim Abbas Syed, Mohamed Ahmed Syed
pmc-13423636.description: BackgroundAtrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common arrhythmia in clinical practice, and its prevalence is increasing in aging populations. It is a leading cause of acute stroke, heart failure, and other cardiovascular morbidities. AF is often asymptomatic and is frequently diagnosed late, typically after a patient presents with acute stroke.

pmc-13536578.title: Whole health and chiropractic: a commentary on historical roots, contemporary relevance, and future directions
pmc-13536578.creator: Michele Maiers, Krista Ward, Michael Ramcharan, Logan Benjamin, Wren Burton, Zachary Cupler, Maruti Ram Gudavalli, Stephanie Halloran, Benjamin Holmes, Steven Huybrecht, Jeremy Jenkins, Claire D Johnson, Nathaniel C Majoris, Alex Margrave, Elizabeth Moos, Vanessa Morales, Ryan D Muller, Steven Passm
pmc-13536578.description: BackgroundThis commentary describes perspectives from workshop attendees at a North American educational conference on the chiropractic profession and its relationship with whole health. Whole Health is a paradigm shift within healthcare settings and funding agencies in the United States that utilizes a systems framework to transform healthcare.

pmc-13679853.title: Sagittal Long-Axis Bladder Diameter and CT-Measured Bladder Wall Thickness in Healthy Female Patients
pmc-13679853.creator: Gavin L Feinberg, Celine Torkzad, Martha K Terris, Pardeep K Mittal, Michael R Torkzad
pmc-13679853.description: Objective: The objective of this study is to evaluate the association between CT-measured bladder wall thickness (BWT) and sagittal long-axis bladder diameter (SL), defined as the largest midsagittal luminal bladder diameter, in female patients without documented bladder disease or urinary symptoms, using SL as a practical indicator of bladder distension.

uslaw-usc-t43-s2902.title: 43 U.S.C. § 2902 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t43-s2902.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t43-s2902.description: United States Code, Title 43 (Public Lands); Chapter 47 (Reclamation Title Transfer). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In this chapter: (1) Conveyed property The term “conveyed property” means an eligible facility that has been conveyed to a qualifying entity under section 2903 of this title. (2) Eligible facility The term “eligible facility” means a facility that meets the criteria for potential transfer.
